exposure: Level of education (none, elementary, high school, some college, college degree)
Women with only high school education
outcome: Maternal cesarean complications (hysterectomy, uterine atony, blood transfusion, surgical injury, arterial ligation, infection, wound complication, ileus)
cohort: 10,344 nulliparous women with live, non-anomalous singleton gestations who underwent primary cesarean delivery
finding: Women with only elementary or high school education had a higher incidence of maternal cesarean complications compared to women with a college degree, after adjusting for potential confounding variables.
mod_finding: This study found that women with lower levels of education had higher odds of cesarean complications and neonatal morbidity.
